notes.title: Feedback from the players and some thoughts from the creator
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 💚

First of all—huge thanks for playing Oddventure and for all the incredible support so far. It truly means the world to us as a small indie team!

https://i.imgur.com/VpvQDty.gif

I’ve been keeping a close eye on your overall feedback, but I’m especially focused on everything related to the combat system. One of the key things I want to improve is the number and flow of encounters. I'm watching how players react, including checking out gameplay videos on YouTube and Twitch reuploads—those are amazing resources that show natural reactions and pacing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37849570/1d3fc94a1f771363971ff816335ab48663ebd650.png

For the full release:
I’ll be working on hitting that sweet spot with the amount of combat—not too much, not too little. One of the takeaways from Early Access is that more fights should be optional, so we’ll be adjusting enemy movement to allow players to sneak past them if they want. That way, both those who enjoy combat and those who want to grind can play their way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37849570/2f1fa70558f69dac4b3b34119d488fc13b97db83.png

I also agree with you all that more skill variety in battles would be great—that’s definitely in the plans. 

The idea behind EA was to not overwhelm players with too much at once, especially with the new systems we introduced. But for the full version, you can expect more abilities for characters and more strategic options.

Oh—and we heard you loud and clear: combat sound effects are getting a rework based on your feedback! 🎧

And on a fun note… quite a few people have already asked about Oddventure plushies. All I can say is—hell yeah, I can't imagine the world of Oddventure without a plush Mr. Rabbit, Dodo, and more down the line! 🧸💥

Thanks again for being part of this journey with us. You’re amazing!

notes.title: Oddventure is Officially Here – Launching Today!
notes.content:
Oddventure is Officially Here – Launching Today!

The wait is over! After a long and exciting journey, we are beyond thrilled to announce that Oddventure is officially launching today! As a small indie studio, we’ve poured our hearts into crafting this adventure, and now it’s time for you to join Charlie on her thrilling quest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37849570/73d076cb2d4a34cf15fce54d2b851fd32d4289b2.png

🎉 Launch Day Special: Enjoy a 10% Discount! 🎉
To celebrate this special day, we're offering a 10% launch discount—don't miss out on this limited-time deal!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1235710/Oddventure/

What Awaits You in Oddventure?

- Approximately 3 hours of gameplay packed with unexpected twists and deep storytelling.

- A unique combat system offering strategic depth and multiple solutions for every encounter.

- New enemies and beautifully designed locations to explore.

- A branching narrative shaped by your choices, ensuring a truly personalized experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37849570/d6c80b3f1b3acac5baab8aff16aa6ef895a69b00.png

Key Features:

- Choice-Driven Narrative – Your decisions shape the fate of characters and the world around you.

- Turn-Based Combat with a Twist – Fight, talk, or run—every encounter offers multiple solutions.

- Dark Humor & Emotional Depth – A unique blend of satire and heartfelt storytelling.

- Hand-Drawn Pixel Art – Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted world of stunning visuals.

- Multiple Endings – Your journey, your story, your consequences.

Watch the Launch Trailer!

Haven’t seen it yet? Check out our brand-new launch trailer and get a glimpse of the adventure ahead! Let us know your thoughts—we can’t wait to hear your feedback!

[previewyoutube=EvjjRWJx9zw;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your incredible support. This is a huge milestone for us, and we couldn’t have done it without you. Be sure to follow us on social media and join our Discord community to share your experiences and connect with the team.

Welcome to Oddventure—let the journey begin!

notes.title: Oddventure – Your Choice, Your Story. Early Access Begins 3.04!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that our game will officially launch in Early Access on April 3, 2025! As a small indie studio, the journey has been challenging, but we’ve worked tirelessly to bring the game to a state we’re proud of. Now, it’s time for you to embark on an adventure and join Charlie in her thrilling quest.

What’s Included in Early Access?

In this Early Access release, you’ll enjoy:

 Approximately 3 hours of gameplay filled with exciting narrative twists.
 A brand-new combat system that offers strategic depth and unique solutions for every encounter.
 New enemies and locations to explore.
 Multiple story paths shaped by your choices, ensuring a personalized experience.


Key Features:

 Choice-Driven Narrative – Your decisions shape the fate of characters and the world around you.
 Turn-Based Combat with a Twist – Fight, talk, or run—every encounter offers multiple solutions.
 Dark Humor & Emotional Depth – A unique blend of satire and heartfelt storytelling.
 Hand-Drawn Pixel Art – Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted world of stunning visuals.
 Multiple Endings – Your journey, your story, your consequences.



New Trailer Alert!
We’ve also prepared a brand-new trailer showcasing what’s to come. Let us know your thoughts—we can’t wait to hear your feedback!

[previewyoutube=EvjjRWJx9zw;full][/previewyoutube]

Let’s make this adventure unforgettable!
